source.quote: We are supported by HSBC as Principal Partner, Cathay, DHL, Casio, Hong Kong Sports Institute, Nan Fung Group
source.note: Undated club page; date is the day it was opened. Front placement: HSBC's large white hexagon logo is printed across the chest in the official product photos of the HKCR Men's 2026/27 15's Home Replica Jersey on HKCR's Castore-run shop (merchandise.hkrugby.com/products/hkcr-mens-2026-27-15s-home-replica-jersey, images cdn/shop/files/TM16994-020-MNQ-01.jpg, -07 and -08; the shop banner announces '15s 2026/27 HOME + AWAY - NOW LIVE'), with the Castore logo on the right chest and the HKCR dragon crest on the left. source.quote: We are supported by HSBC as Principal Partner, Cathay, DHL, Casio, Hong Kong Sports Institute, Nan Fung Group

source.name: Hong Kong China Rugby: Hong Kong China Rugby Elevates Partnership With DHL Express Hong Kong
source.quote: the DHL logo will proudly display on the back of the playing jersey (below the number) for Hong Kong China 7s and 15s representative teams
source.note: Partnership extended through to 2029, so it covers the 2026/27 season. The yellow DHL logo below the number area is visible on the official 2026/27 home replica product photo (merchandise.hkrugby.com, cdn/shop/files/TM16994-020-MNQ-02.jpg).

source.name: Hong Kong China Rugby: Hong Kong China Rugby Announces Premier Partnership With Castore
source.quote: This collaboration will see Castore outfit the Hong Kong China’s 7s and 15s representative stars with top-tier playing, training and travel apparel
source.note: Multi-year kit-supply partnership announced 11 October 2024 (replacing Kukri Sports); Castore logo on the right chest of the 2026/27 home replica (official product photos TM16994-020-MNQ-01/-07) and the shop is 'HKCR Shop by Castore' (merchandise.hkrugby.com). Listed per the convention for kit makers.

summary: HSBC's white hexagon across the front of the navy Castore home shirt, with the Castore logo and the HKCR dragon crest on the chest. The back carries CATHAY across the upper back and the yellow DHL logo below the number. Both sleeves show only red-and-white trim and the Hong Kong flag patch — no sleeve sponsor — and the hem carries only Castore's 'Authentic Product' label. Every placement checked against the six official product photos of the HKCR Men's 2026/27 15's Home Replica Jersey on the official Castore-run shop (merchandise.hkrugby.com), which launched the 2026/27 home and away shirts with the banner '15s 2026/27 HOME + AWAY - NOW LIVE'.
